verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an AI assistant product, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes Copilot as a Microsoft-hosted service on Copilot.com, mobile apps and Microsoft 365 apps, with no documented self-hosted or on-premises deployment. The note that Browse with Copilot actions 'run locally in your browser' describes a client-side automation feature, not self-hosting the core product, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
